title: SIDESTORY: STULTIFERA NAVIS OPEN
lines: 01 [GIFT OF THE DEEP ONES] SIDE STORY: STULTIFERA NAVIS OPEN
DETAILS: Stultifera Navis event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by exploring event map, clearing event
stages, completing certain event, opening Treasure Chests, and redeeming from the event shop.
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
EVENT STAGES DURATION: Event Stages will open in several phases:
- [Gran Faro] Duration: November 3, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - November 24, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- [Lost Flagship] Duration: November 3, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - November 24, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- [Nameless Ocean] Duration: November 3, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - November 24, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- [Dusty Picturebook] Duration: November 10, 2022, 16:00 (UTC-7) - November 24, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- [Mirror Image] Duration: November 17, 2022, 16:00 (UTC-7) - November 24, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[GRAN FARO] [LOST FLAGSHIP] [NAMELESS OCEAN]
DETAILS: During the event, you can obtain event rewards by exploring event map, clearing event stages, completing certain event, opening
Treasure Chests.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★★: Lumen, Bloodline of Combat Collection - Shore Rescue Modification for Lancet-2, Stultifera Navis Reception Room Furniture (Pieces), Rusted Compass, and more.
[BITTERSCALE TAVERN]
DURATION: November 3, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - December 1, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, you can collect [Rusted Compass] by participating the event and use them to redeem items as rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: Lumen’s Token, Stultifera Navis Reception Room Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records,
Furniture Parts, etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Public Affairs. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Public Affairs.
The event stages will be permanently added to the [Intermezzi] after the end of the event.
02 LIMITED HEADHUNTING OPEN - ABYSS CORROSION
DURATION: November 3, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - November 17, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited Headhunting, [Abyss Corrosion], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this
Limited Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Specter the Unchained (Limited) / Irene
★★★★★★: W (Limited) / Rosmontis (Limited) / Skadi the Corrupting Heart (Limited)
★★★★★: Windflit
NOTE:
[Abyss Corrosion] is part of the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration] headhunting series.
[Limited Headhunting - Celebration] is Limited Headhunting.
Operator Irene and Windflit will be permanently added to other Standard Headhunting in future update.
Operator Specter the Unchained is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration], and is NOT available in any Standard
Headhunting.
Operator Specter the Unchained will not be available from other Limited Headhunting.
NOTE: Please refer to the official notice of this Limited Headhunting for more details.

04 [GIFT OF THE DEEP ONES] DAILY FREE ROLL IN LIMITED HEADHUNTING

DETAILS: The following Operators will be added to the game.

NOTE:
Operator Specter the Unchained is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration], and is NOT available in any Standard
Headhunting.
Players who purchased Cambrian 1096 Winter New Arrivals - Undercurrent for Specter with Originium before 11/3, 10:00 (UTC-7), will receive an Outfit Voucher via mail on 11/5, 10:00 (UTC-7).
Operator Lumen is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Stultifera Navis, and is NOT available in [Abyss Corrosion], any Standard
Headhunting or Recruit.
Operator Irene and Windflit will be permanently added to other Standard Headhunting in future update.
Operator Specter the Unchained, Irene, Lumen, and Windflit will gain more trust in the event stages.

11 [GIFT OF THE DEEP ONES] GOURD VALLEY MINING AREA OPEN
DURATION: November 3, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - November 17, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can perform a mining operation in the Gourd Valley Mining Area every day, and the possible types of ore can
be extracted are: Originium Crude Ore, Originium Ore, and Originium Vein. Extracted ore will be directly processed into Orundum.
- Originium Crude Ore is worth 400 Orundums, Originium Vein is worth 1000 Orundums, and Originium Ore's value varies between Originium Crude
Ore and Originium Vein, the exact value of which will be shown after it has been processed.
- Mining operation can only be performed once a day, and its usage permit will reset at 04:00 every day.
- If the mining operation fails to extract a Vein, the chance to encounter an Originium Vein will increase on the next attempt. If the mining operation
extracts a Vein, that Vein will disappear afterwards.
- The mining period will be split into three stages: 1st to 5th day, 6th to 10th day, 11th to 14th day. Within each stage, if no Veins are found before the
last day of the stage, professionals will be there to guide the Rhodes Island prospecting team to the location of a Vein on the last day, a.k.a. the 5th,
10th and 14th day. Can directly receive 1000 Orundum after extraction.
12 [GIFT OF THE DEEP ONES] ROUTINE CONTENT REWARDS UPGRADES
DETAILS: Routine content rewards upgrades are as follows:
[NEW PRTS PROXY ANNIHILATION CARD]
OPENS AT: November 7, 2022, 04:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Use PRTS Proxy Annihilation Card in Annihilation stages to activate Total Proxy Auto Deploy. It will skip the battle and use the highest
number of the Annihilation (without a support unit) to calculate the reward. You can receive PRTS Proxy Annihilation Cards by completing
Daily Missions.
NOTE: For Annihilation stages that have unlocked Auto Deploy, it is required to have completed Annihilation (including Auto Deploy) without
using a support unit after 04:00 on November 7 in order to record the highest numbers of enemies defeated and be able to use PRTS Proxy
Annihilation Card.
[SANITY POTION CAPACITY UPGRADE]
DETAILS: The [Emergency Sanity Potion] available daily from the Monthly Card will be automatically upgraded to [Emergency Sanity Booster]
from 04:00 on November 3, and the Sanity capacity will be increased from 60 to 80. The [Top Emergency Sanity Potion] available daily from the
Weekly Missions will be automatically upgraded to [Emergency Sanity Concentrate] from 04:00 on November 7, and the Sanity capacity will be
increased from 100 to 120.
NOTE: Previously obtained [Emergency Sanity Potion] and [Top Emergency Sanity Potion] will not be automatically upgraded.
[DAILY / WEEKLY MISSION REWARD UPGRADE]
OPENS AT: November 7, 2022, 04:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Added two new types of reward content to the Daily Missions Reward:
Type One: PRTS Proxy Annihilation Card * 1
Type Two: LMD * 6000, Tactical Battle Record * 6
Added a new type of reward content to the Weekly Missions Reward: LMD * 10000, Strategic Battle Record * 5
[NEW SUPPLIES STAGES]
OPENS AT: November 3, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS:
New Cargo Escort stage CE-6, Experimental Material Escort.
New Tactical Drill stage LS-6, Wargame Drill.
